concerns.aging: One reviewer reports the mask tightens the skin well and helps with forehead wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report their skin feels dry or dehydrated right after peeling the mask off, which they describe as an expected effect of a peel-off formula that a moisturizer resolves.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation, including some who peeled it off slowly and carefully; one reviewer, however, reports getting burns on her nose despite following every instruction.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers are split on blackhead removal: several report the mask pulls a large amount of dirt and blackheads out of their pores, especially around the nose, while others, including one who tested different application methods and tried it on a second person, report it removed dead skin and oil but did nothing for their blackheads.

aspects.libelle: Peeling it off can be quite painful
Can catch and pull eyebrow or hairline hair painfully
Needs a thin, even layer or it will not dry properly
Small container, but a little product goes a long way

extraits.texte: Peel off black mask dries within 12-15 minutes and ready to remove. Product doesn’t smell any bad or good. Product did NOT remove any blackheads nor whiteheads . All it removes is a bunch of tiny facial hair. Doesn’t worth apply on your skin.

extraits.titre: Not safe at all... got burns on my nose....
extraits.texte: Please don't buy it unless you want burns on your face... Followed every single instruction but now can't leave the house...

extraits.titre: Crappy product, doesn't even do what's advertised.
extraits.texte: I had very severe cystic acne throughout my puberty, I'm still dealing with the aftermath of it years later, I'm now 20 years old and I of course like any other young person get fooled by advertising online, this is one of them, not only does this not remove blackheads, but it also does... you guessed it, absolutely nothing. It doesn't make your skin smoother, it doesn't remove blackheads, it does exactly that, nothing. If anything it just felt nice removing it ( a bit painful too ) and having your skin be smooth for like an hour, but thats about the extent of it. I might have some hard blackheads, who knows I'm not a dermatologist, but the product doesn't do as advertised. The substance is slimy, and cold, you can use the little spatula that it comes with, but you're still gonna make a mess because of how slimy the substance is. It's somewhat hard to get off your skin if you touch it, you have to scrub with water for about 40 seconds. But yea uh don't buy this crap, it does nothing. If anyone is telling you otherwise because, oh I tried it my skin was so nice after using it, it's because they probably don't have bad blackheads or just use this for no reason.

The main reason I got this was to remove the blackheads that have been on my nose for a long time. Unfortunately, it wasn't able to do that. It cleaned out some dead skin and removed the oils which is nice, but that's not exactly what I wanted it for. I took all the advice from the other reviews, putting more on and waiting a longer time. However the half dozen times I've used it I've gotten the same results no matter what I changed. I even got my girlfriend to try it and it had similar results with her. So for the price it really isn't that bad as a cleansing mask, especially with how much you get. But at least for me it didn't work at removing any blackheads.

i’m only docking one star off because peeling this face mask off was like peeling my own skin off. the mask dries really well (i did a thin coat) and works amazing! the peeling part was the W O R S T! it made both my eyes water and i had to stop and take a break. the smell isn’t the worst and my skin feels very dry after but i did cleanse before and after and then used moisturizer. If you don’t mind the pain, this mask does indeed work.

This product REALLY works. It pulled out 95% of everything out of my pores. It got all my blackheads, and peach fuzz off as well (which is sounding I wanted) and left my skin feeling SO smooth. If you don’t want to peel off a certain spot on your face, it comes off very easy with a wash cloth and warm water. It dries fast, doesn’t leave any sort of staining on your skin either. When applying, it leaves a cool refreshing feeling on your skin. The ONLY thing I could say, is my skin felt a bit dehydrated afterwards, but that is to be expected with a peel off, and nothing some face cream can’t fix. If you are looking for a great black head peel off mask, I highly recommend this one.
